notes: KNOWN FAILING: DeepSeek Harness ships a foreground workflow tool that fans out three parallel spawn-provider children and writes each distinct childId into durable tool-workflow records. Each child transcript header carries parentSession. The DSH adapter rejects bare-UUID child directories and declares no ParentSessionIDFromPath extractor, so the correct spec requires three distinct child sessions and parent links that cannot appear today. Transcript assertions make the fixture non-vacuous by requiring one named workflow call, exactly three distinct durable workflow members, three completed member endings, and the successful three-agent result. The driver pins qwen/qwen3.5-9b; local-route cost can remain zero.
